name: Mycofall
description:
About This Game

Mycofall is a bullet heaven title that offers fast gameplay, deep playstyle and build optimization and a unique mushroom core loop that blends collecting resources and killing creeps.

No aiming is required, you focus on moving, dashing, dodging, making build decisions and collecting your primary resource: mycelium. It spawns as you kill insects, the faster you, the more mushrooms spawn, got the idea? Perfect for the min-maxing kind of players, huh?

Face endless waves of twisted insects in our fantasy bullet-hell survivors-like setting. Play solo or team up online, share progress, and combine powers to stand against the swarm together. If you are looking for a game like Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor or The Spell Brigade our game is for you!

The unique mushroom core loop blends killing creeps and collecting your main resource mycelium that spawns as you kill enemies. If you want to master Mycofall's core mechanic you'll need to build your own playstyle that allows you perfect pathing to collect the mycelium while killing enough creeps to trigger the mushroom respawn-o-meter.

If you struggle to climb up the leaderboard it's most likely because you screw up paying attention to this system. No worries it takes some time and practice to improve your mycelium-per-minute-rate (mpm - yeah, that's a real metric).

In Mycofall your character holds up to 6 skills — but you'll spend most of your time leveling, evolving and morphing them rather than adding new ones. Want a crit-build? Done. Lifesteal setup? Yup. The "Fast Boi"-Build? Sure. You define how each skill behaves, what perks it gets, and what enemies it targets. And then combine it all for broken synergies.

Dive into character perk-sets that shift your entire playstyle, plus 15+ attributes like speed, mycelium-bonus-rate, armor, hp-regen, dash-range and more. The build space is deep. Craft your own, and climb the leaderboard.

Nothing kills replayability faster than missing meta progression. That's why Mycofall offers a vast library of permanent unlocks — giving you even more options and flexibility to define your own build. Unlock characters, skills and perks using one currency: The purple Meta Mushrooms.

Why spend hundreds of hours in a bullet heaven? Either you're grinding an audiobook/evergreen sitcom, or you're chasing the top 100. Maybe even top 10. Mycofall's global leaderboards are split by difficulty and player count, because comparing a 4-player difficulty 3 co-op run to a soloplayer difficulty 1 session isn't fair. Clean, transparent, competitive.

And now dive into the woods! Download the Demo, hit the wishlist button and munch some shrooms bugs creeps.
short_desc: Mycofall is a survivors-like auto-shooter with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Defeat hordes of infected insects to evolve and morph powerful abilities and weapons. Collect mycelium, grow stronger, unlock permanent upgrades and defend the forest solo or in online co-op.
